newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraq seeks 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iraq seeks 50,000 tonnes U.S. wheat - trade.

text.p: Iraq is in the world grain market with a tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for August or September, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
Results of the tender launched under a United Nations oil-for-food plan are expected in early August.
Grain exporters said however it was unclear whether the tender would lead to any purchase, after Iraq failed to buy at various previous tenders for American wheat.
"We don't know whether the Iraqis will buy or not," said one.
Iraq's reason for not buying on the previous occasions was not known.
The current tender is the first for the current 1997/98 seeason.
